assets.label: porosity_fields.png（孔隙率场云图）

resolution_check.check: name in §④ bold lead-in AND record.figures[].name match AND png_base64 non-empty

locator.quote: **porosity_fields.png** — Porosity field phi(x,t) of one steady snapshot per scenario on the required grid h = 5 d50. White dots are particle centres. The field is built from exact circle/rectangle intersections, so its area integral reproduces the global porosity to round-off (audited per run, <= 1e-12).

assets.label: mu_of_I_fit.png（μ–I 拟合与场景点）

resolution_check.check: name in §④ bold lead-in AND record.figures[].name match AND png_base64 non-empty

locator.quote: **mu_of_I_fit.png** — Measured friction coefficient against the inertial number for the three scenarios, one point per (scenario, imposed rate) with the seed as replicate; error bars are the standard error over seeds. Solid line: pooled element-test law; dashed: simple-shear element test alone. Pooled R^2 = 0.803, shear-only R^2 = 0.920; the channel points (mu ~ 0.07-0.10) are drag dominated and are a validation case, not calibration data.

assets.note: 图名+caption 在 §④ 可定位；PNG 像素字节未随报告记录附带。 记录侧 figures[] 命中=True，png_base64 长度=0。

assets.label: mu_I_residuals.png（主判据残差与容差带）

resolution_check.check: name in §④ bold lead-in AND record.figures[].name match AND png_base64 non-empty

locator.quote: **mu_I_residuals.png** — Residuals of the pooled element-test quadratic fit with the pre-registered residual tolerance (+-0.05). The residual standard deviation is inside the tolerance band, yet R^2 stays below 0.95 because the friction range spanned by the data is only ~0.10; the residuals are structured by solid fraction, not random.

resolution_check.check: name in §④ bold lead-in AND record.figures[].name match AND png_base64 non-empty

locator.quote: **force_chain_vs_I.png** — Coordination number Z, strong-network anisotropy A_c and the share of the load carried by the 20 % strongest contacts, per run. Z stays in the isostatic band (3-4 in 2-D) over two decades of I, while A_c grows with I: the backbone becomes more directional as the flow gets faster.
